from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem, rdMolDescriptors
from rdkit.Chem import rdDistGeom, rdForceFieldHelpers
import math, os

smiles = 'CC(C)CCC[C@@H](C)[C@H]1CC[C@@H]2[C@@]1(C)CC[C@H]3[C@H]2CC=C4[C@@]3(C)CC[C@@H](C4)O'
mol = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smiles)
assert mol is not None
molH = Chem.AddHs(mol)
print('formula', rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(molH), 'atoms', molH.GetNumAtoms())

params = rdDistGeom.ETKDGv3()
params.randomSeed = 0xC07E57E01
params.pruneRmsThresh = 0.15
params.useSmallRingTorsions = True
params.useMacrocycleTorsions = True
params.enforceChirality = True
conf_ids = rdDistGeom.EmbedMultipleConfs(molH, numConfs=40, params=params)
print('embedded conformers', len(conf_ids))
if len(conf_ids) == 0:
    # fallback
    cid = rdDistGeom.EmbedMolecule(molH, params)
    conf_ids = [cid]

# Optimize conformers with MMFF94s if available, else UFF
energies = []
mmff_ok = rdForceFieldHelpers.MMFFHasAllMoleculeParams(molH)
print('MMFF ok', mmff_ok)
if mmff_ok:
    res = rdForceFieldHelpers.MMFFOptimizeMoleculeConfs(molH, mmffVariant='MMFF94s', maxIters=5000, ignoreInterfragInteractions=True)
    energies = [e for conv, e in res]
else:
    res = rdForceFieldHelpers.UFFOptimizeMoleculeConfs(molH, maxIters=5000, ignoreInterfragInteractions=True)
    energies = [e for conv, e in res]
print('energies min/max', min(energies), max(energies))
best = conf_ids[energies.index(min(energies))]
print('best conf', best, 'energy', min(energies))

# Write XYZ manually with comment line
conf = molH.GetConformer(best)
with open('answer.xyz', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"{molH.GetNumAtoms()}\n")
    f.write("cholesterol (cholest-5-en-3beta-ol), RDKit ETKDGv3 + MMFF94s\n")
    for atom in molH.GetAtoms():
        p = conf.GetAtomPosition(atom.GetIdx())
        f.write(f"{atom.GetSymbol():2s} {p.x: .8f} {p.y: .8f} {p.z: .8f}\n")

# quick geometry validation
molH2 = Chem.MolFromXYZFile('answer.xyz')
print('xyz atoms read', molH2.GetNumAtoms() if molH2 else None)
# compute bonded and nonbonded distances from coordinates
pos = conf.GetPositions()
min_nb = 1e9; min_pair=None
for i in range(molH.GetNumAtoms()):
    for j in range(i+1, molH.GetNumAtoms()):
        d = math.dist(pos[i], pos[j])
        b = molH.GetBondBetweenAtoms(i,j)
        if b is None and d < min_nb:
            min_nb = d; min_pair=(i,j,molH.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetSymbol(),molH.GetAtomWithIdx(j).GetSymbol())
print('min nonbonded distance', min_nb, min_pair)
# list unusual bond lengths
bl=[]
for b in molH.GetBonds():
    i=b.GetBeginAtomIdx(); j=b.GetEndAtomIdx(); d=math.dist(pos[i],pos[j])
    bl.append((d,i,j,molH.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetSymbol(),molH.GetAtomWithIdx(j).GetSymbol(),str(b.GetBondType())))
print('bond length min/max', min(x[0] for x in bl), max(x[0] for x in bl))
print('longest bonds', sorted(bl, reverse=True)[:5])
print('shortest bonds', sorted(bl)[:5])

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import rdMolDescriptors
from rdkit.Chem import rdDetermineBonds
orig = Chem.MolFromSmiles('CC(C)CCC[C@@H](C)[C@H]1CC[C@@H]2[C@@]1(C)CC[C@H]3[C@H]2CC=C4[C@@]3(C)CC[C@@H](C4)O')
orig_can = Chem.MolToSmiles(orig, True)
xyz = Chem.MolFromXYZFile('answer.xyz')
print('xyz atoms', xyz.GetNumAtoms(), 'bonds', xyz.GetNumBonds())
rdDetermineBonds.DetermineBonds(xyz, useHueckel=False, charge=0, covFactor=1.3, allowChargedFragments=False, embedChiral=True)
print('after bonds', xyz.GetNumBonds())
heavy = Chem.RemoveHs(xyz)
print('read formula', rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(heavy), 'heavy atoms', heavy.GetNumAtoms())
Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(heavy)
read_can = Chem.MolToSmiles(heavy, True)
print('orig', orig_can)
print('read', read_can)
print('isomeric match', read_can == orig_can)
print('chiral centers read', Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(heavy, includeUnassigned=True, useLegacyImplementation=False))
